probe.name: V_NEW5_single_stage
probe.sql:
SELECT ts_dedup.timestamp,
       sum(md_per_bldg.bldg_metadata_rows) AS metadata_rows_count,
       max(md_per_bldg.model_count_per_row) AS model_count,
       sum(md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS units_count,
       sum(ts_dedup.bs_elec * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS elec_baseline,
       sum(ts_dedup.up_elec * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS elec_upgrade,
       sum((coalesce(ts_dedup.bs_elec,0) - coalesce(ts_dedup.up_elec,0)) * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS elec_savings,
       sum(ts_dedup.bs_gas * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS gas_baseline,
       sum(ts_dedup.up_gas * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS gas_upgrade,
       sum((coalesce(ts_dedup.bs_gas,0) - coalesce(ts_dedup.up_gas,0)) * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS gas_savings
FROM (
  SELECT ts.bldg_id,
         date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp)) AS timestamp,
         CAST(sum(ts."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption") FILTER (WHERE ts.upgrade=0) AS DOUBLE) / count(distinct ts.state) AS bs_elec,
         CAST(sum(ts."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption") FILTER (WHERE ts.upgrade=1) AS DOUBLE) / count(distinct ts.state) AS up_elec,
         CAST(sum(ts."out.natural_gas.total.energy_consumption") FILTER (WHERE ts.upgrade=0) AS DOUBLE) / count(distinct ts.state) AS bs_gas,
         CAST(sum(ts."out.natural_gas.total.energy_consumption") FILTER (WHERE ts.upgrade=1) AS DOUBLE) / count(distinct ts.state) AS up_gas
  FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state AS ts
  WHERE ts.upgrade IN (0, 1) AND ts.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
    AND (ts.bldg_id, ts.state) IN (
      SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs
      WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1) AND bs.applicability=true AND bs.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
      GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs.state HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade))=1
    )
  GROUP BY ts.bldg_id, date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp))
) AS ts_dedup
JOIN (
  SELECT bs.bldg_id,
         sum(bs.weight) AS bldg_weight,
         count(*) AS bldg_metadata_rows,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bs.bldg_id ASC) +
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bs.bldg_id DESC) - 1
         AS model_count_per_row
  FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs
  WHERE bs.upgrade=0 AND bs.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
    AND (bs.bldg_id, bs.state) IN (
  SELECT bs2.bldg_id, bs2.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs2
  WHERE bs2.upgrade IN (1) AND bs2.applicability=true AND bs2.state IN ('CO', 'NM')
  GROUP BY bs2.bldg_id, bs2.state HAVING count(distinct(bs2.upgrade))=1
)
  GROUP BY bs.bldg_id
) AS md_per_bldg ON ts_dedup.bldg_id = md_per_bldg.bldg_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
